# Q-049: 10 SHOP bought for 1,000.00 CAD and 4 sold for 600.00 CAD, written
# as a book that keeps no cost bases writes them: the sale states no cost
# basis, is valued at the 400.00 the 4 shares were bought for, and its
# `$residual$` split states the realized gain, 200.00.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_a_book_can_keep_no_cost_bases.py.
2026-01-01 commodity SHOP
	mnemonic: "SHOP"
	fullname: "Shopify Inc"
	namespace: "TSX"
	fraction: 10000
2026-07-01 open Assets:Shares
	type: "Stock"
	commodity.namespace: "TSX"
	commodity.mnemonic: "SHOP"
2026-07-01 open Income:Capital gains
	type: "Income"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-08-05 * "Shares bought"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Shares 10 SHOP
		value: "1000.00"
	Assets:Chequing -1000.00 CAD
2026-09-10 * "Shares sold"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Shares -4 SHOP
		value: "-400.00"
	Assets:Chequing 600.00 CAD
	Income:Capital gains $residual$ CAD
